subject: ClearBank POC - success criteria, kickoff & weekly plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: ClearBank POC - recap & proposed success criteria

Hi Sophie / Daniel —

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a shared plan for the POC:

Scope (what we'll validate)
- Real-time customer support summarization (avg latency < 250ms per request)
- Retrieval-augmented responses across your internal KB (precision on top-3 results >= 85%)
- Cost projection: target token cost < $0.002 per request at projected throughput

Proposed success criteria (suggested)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for 99% of sample queries
- Quality: human eval >= 4/5 on 50 representative prompts you provide
- Stability: no more than 2 service interruptions during 2-week trial

Timeline & ownership
- Kickoff prep & access: this week (owner: ClearBank infra / Sophie)
- Baseline test & config: Redwood infra + Marcus (week 1)
- Weekly check-ins: Fridays 10:00 UK time (owner: Marissa)

Attachments: I've attached an initial SOW and our access instructions to help your infra team set up test credentials.

Next steps
1) Can you confirm the success criteria above or call out changes?
2) Please share a small sample set of 50 representative prompts and a test user (or service) we can use for end-to-end validation.
3) Procurement: if you can loop in procurement contacts, we'll prepare a short SOW for sign-off.

Happy to jump on a follow-up if helpful — thanks!

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: redwood-access-instructions.md
